name: Semantic Isomorphism to Constraint Satisfaction
description: Reframe the graph connectivity / linear algebra problem as a boolean constraint satisfaction task. The objective is to select a minimum-cost set of equality constraints such that all valid boolean assignments have the target variables sharing the same value. This prevents the LLM from mapping the problem to Steiner Tree, as it lacks spatial, graph, or dimension keywords, instead appearing as a 2-SAT or logic puzzle.
